svg.title: Plot it first. Then bring an effect size.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Plot it first. Then bring an effect size.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing a clearly parabolic scatter plot annotated with a Pearson correlation of minus 0.02 ringed in red and labelled blind while mutual information reads 0.98, and a sine-wave scatter with correlation plus 0.24 against mutual information 0.91; a table showing a two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test flagging a shift of one hundredth of a standard deviation zero percent of the time at a thousand samples and a hundred percent of the time at a million; a two-gate design requiring both a p-value below 0.01 and a KS statistic above 0.1; and a numbered six-step EDA checklist.
svg.text: Plot it first. Then bring an effect size.
draw it from memory, then compare
